text: Show reflections of similar ideas' connections in create_idea's review step
description:
Research cycle 2026-11-08 (EXG: Self-Evolving Agents with Experience Graphs, arXiv 2605.17721). create_idea's first call already returns up to 8 related active/cancelled ideas. Add a short warning block from their parent connections, kept lean against information overload (Felix 2026-11-08):
- only reflections that did NOT hold or are unclear (failures warn; successes add little),
- at most 3, from the most similar related ideas, above a similarity threshold,
- one line each: similar bet "<hypothesis>" -> did not hold: <first sentence of reflection>,
- omit the block entirely when nothing qualifies, so most calls are unchanged.
Small change in packages/mcp/src/tools/ideas.ts review step; the harness context compiler can reuse the same selection.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 research cycle. Felix worried about information overload; scoped down to max 3 one-line warnings from failed/unclear bets, omitted when none qualify.
